rationale.conceptual: The method uses DFT with M06-2X/D3 and BSSE correction—an established but non‑trivial approach. It requires accurately building face‑bonded and edge‑bonded carbon models, placing sulfur species in multiple conformations, and correctly pre‑optimizing and refining, which goes beyond a standard textbook protocol.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves model generation, dozens of DFT geometry optimizations (at least 48 complexes × multiple conformers), separate isolated species calculations, and post‑processing with BSSE correction. Managing many independent runs with a quantum chemistry package (e.g., ORCA, Psi4) and potentially parallel resources makes the orchestration lengthy and fragile.
